name: settings-and-icons
summary: Dedicated settings panel; unify all icons on Lucide
body:
A Fork-style preferences modal (appearance: theme/language as
segmented controls; integration: agent command and ism binary path,
saved on change, Esc/backdrop to close, app version in the footer)
replaces the two raw selects in the statusbar. Every icon is now
Lucide (ISC) at a consistent stroke: toolbar verbs, sidebar views,
project-rail add, terminal and the new settings gear — SF Symbols
themselves are licensed for Apple-platform rendering only and cannot
be bundled into an Electron app.
